description: Blueprint helps kids build the next part of their story with the LEGO bricks they already own.
short: Blueprint turns the bricks kids already own into the things they imagine.

features.name: Add your sets
features.body: Tell Blueprint which bricks you have.

features.name: Imagine what happens next
features.body: Describe a character, vehicle, or scene for your story.

features.name: Get a buildable blueprint
features.body: See an idea and step-by-step instructions using your bricks.

features.name: Make it yours
features.body: Change the design, then keep playing.

taglines: Build what you imagine, with what you have.
Imagine it. Build it. Make it yours.
The next chapter is already in your brick box.
